title: Blue Mountain Beach "One More Day" 64 S Spooky Lane
h1: Blue Mountain Beach "One More Day" 64 S Spooky Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gulf front- Amazing views- Steps from the beach- Private pool and sitting spa *Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $60 per day.- Low-Speed Vehicle- Gas fireplace- 4 adult bikes- Elevator- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: One More Day is a stunning 4-bedroom, 5.5-bathroom waterfront home that sleeps 16 in the small, gated community of Blue Mountain Beach. Guests will love being steps from the beach, located directly behind the house, with incredible access to the Gulf of Mexico. Enjoy the use of a private pool and sitting spa!Step inside this beautiful home, where the first floor greets guests with fun and relaxation. Kick back and relax in this additional living space with a queen sleeper sofa and TV. The game area provides endless entertainment with an indoor/outdoor pool table, Pac-Man arcade game, and cornhole boards. There's a wet bar for added convenience. When it's time for fun in the sun, venture outside to the private pool with an attached sitting spa surrounded by a spacious patio with 6 loungers to sunbathe.Take the stairs to access the second-floor great room of this 4-story home. A spacious living area features white linen sofas and soft leather armchairs for maximum comfort when watching TV by the cozy fireplace. French doors spaced throughout the main floor lead out to a large balcony, furnished with plush chairs and an alfresco dining table. The traditional dining area boasts a beautiful coastal shell chandelier overhead and seats 8, while the adjacent breakfast bar seats 4 more. The kitchen is every chef's dream with its granite countertops and spacious kitchen island with built-in appliances. There is 1 guest bedroom on this floor with a king bed.The third floor offers guests 3 spacious bedrooms, each with a luxurious king bed. Enjoy breathtaking views from the covered balcony, accessible from 2 of the bedrooms. There is also a washer and dryer.The top floor is the perfect retreat for kids and young adults. A large TV with a Wii game console next to 3 twin-over-twin bunk beds will keep guests thoroughly entertained. Enjoy access to the top-floor deck overlooking the lovely beach below.This amazing coastal home will have friends and family saying, "One More Day!" With on-site parking for 3 vehicles in the driveway and 4 complimentary adult bikes, it's easy to explore the local area. Book this great location now!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 16)FIRST FLOOR:- Additional Living Area: Queen Sleeper Sofa, Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub SeparateTHIRD FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub SeparateFOURTH FLOOR:-Bunk Room: Three Twin/Twin Bunk Beds

Guests will love being steps from the beach, located directly behind the house, with incredible access to the Gulf of Mexico. Enjoy the use of a private pool and sitting spa! Step inside this beautiful home, where the first floor greets guests with fun and relaxation. Kick back and relax in this additional living space with a queen sleeper sofa and TV. The game area provides endless entertainment with an indoor/outdoor pool table, Pac-Man arcade game, and cornhole boards. There's a wet bar for added convenience. When it's time for fun in the sun, venture outside to the private pool with an attached sitting spa surrounded by a spacious patio with 6 loungers to sunbathe. Take the stairs to access the second-floor great room of this 4-story home. A spacious living area features white linen sofas and soft leather armchairs for maximum comfort when watching TV by the cozy fireplace. French doors spaced throughout the main floor lead out to a large balcony, furnished with plush chairs and an alfresco dining table. The traditional dining area boasts a beautiful coastal shell chandelier overhead and seats 8, while the adjacent breakfast bar seats 4 more. The kitchen is every chef's dream with its granite countertops and spacious kitchen island with built-in appliances. There is 1 guest bedroom on this floor with a king bed. The third floor offers guests 3 spacious bedrooms, each with a luxurious king bed. Enjoy breathtaking views from the covered balcony, accessible from 2 of the bedrooms. There is also a washer and dryer. The top floor is the perfect retreat for kids and young adults. A large TV with a Wii game console next to 3 twin-over-twin bunk beds will keep guests thoroughly entertained. Enjoy access to the top-floor deck overlooking the lovely beach below. This amazing coastal home will have friends and family saying, "One More Day!" With on-site parking for 3 vehicles in the driveway and 4 complimentary adult bikes, it's easy to explore the local area. Book this great location now!
